  "analysis": "The training data reveals that German legal texts contain person entities with complex academic and professional titles (Dr., Mag., Univ.-Prof., Hon.-Prof., etc.) often preceding names, as well as standalone names in party roles.   "strategy": "Use two focused regex rules: one to capture names preceded by common German legal/academic titles (handling variable title lengths), and a second to capture standalone capitalized names in specific legal contexts (e.g., after 'gegen die beklagte Partei' or 'klagenden Partei').",

    {
      "name": "person_with_titles",
      "description": "Captures person names preceded by German academic/professional titles (Dr., Mag., Univ.-Prof., Hon.-Prof., etc.)",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:Univ\\.-?Prof\\.\\s+)?(?:Hon\\.-?Prof\\.\\s+)?(?:Vize)?(?:Senats)?(?:Hof)?(?:Rat|R\u00e4t|R\u00e4tin|R\u00e4tinnen|Pr\u00e4sident|Pr\u00e4sidentin|Vizepr\u00e4sident|Vizepr\u00e4sidentin)\\s+(?:Dr\\.\\s+)?(?:Mag\\.\\s+)?(?:PD\\.\\s+)?(?:PhD\\s+)?([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 10,
      "reasoning": "Matches the most common pattern in legal texts where titles precede names. The capture group $1 isolates the name itself, while the context ensures we only match valid title-name combinations."
    },
    {
      "name": "person_standalone",
      "description": "Captures standalone person names in legal party contexts (e.g., 'gegen die beklagte Partei [Name]')",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:gegen die beklagte Partei|der klagenden Partei|der Antragsteller|des Antragsgegners|des Vaters|der Mutter|des minderj\u00e4hrigen|minderj\u00e4hrigen)\\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 8,
      "reasoning": "Captures names that appear without titles in specific legal role contexts. The context words ensure we don't match random capitalized words."
    },
    {
      "name": "person_with_dr_prefix",
      "description": "Captures names with 'Dr.' prefix but no other title context (fallback for cases like 'Dr. Name')",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "\\bDr\\.\\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"

      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 5,
      "reasoning": "Handles cases where 'Dr.' appears without additional titles like 'Hofrat' or 'Senatspr\u00e4sident'. Lower priority to avoid conflicts with the more specific title rule."
    }
  ],
